top_signals.title: Angola Eyes Panda and Islamic Bonds to Diversify Funding Sources
top_signals.summary: Angola is considering selling bonds in China or tapping Islamic debt markets in the Middle East as the oil-producing nation seeks to diversify its sources of financing, according to a senior finance official.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Norway's $2 trillion wealth fund was frozen out of major defense companies. That may be about to change
top_signals.summary: Existing ethical rules mean the fund is not permitted to invest in companies like Lockheed Martin and Boeing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
